author: priya
text: Found it. pg_stat_activity shows hundreds of idle-in-transaction sessions from payment-service, all on queries from the new saved-payment-methods endpoint. It runs one query per stored payment method (classic N+1) and holds the connection for the whole request. Under morning traffic that exhausts the pool and starves /charges.

author: priya
text:
```
SELECT pid, state, query_start, left(query, 60)
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE application_name = 'payment-service'
AND state = 'idle in transaction';
-- 187 rows
```

author: david
text: Escalating CS-4903 — BrightMart's security team is doing a vendor review and asks: are our webhook payloads signed? They require HMAC verification for compliance. Anyone have the definitive answer + docs link?

author: priya
text: Yes — every webhook is signed with HMAC-SHA256 using the merchant's webhook secret. Signature is in the `X-CloudCart-Signature` header, format `t=<timestamp>,v1=<hex digest>`. Verification guide: https://docs.cloudcart.com/webhooks/signatures. They should also check the timestamp to prevent replay (we recommend a 5-minute tolerance).

author: david
text: Perfect, exactly what I needed. Relaying to BrightMart with the docs link. Marking CS-4903 resolved.
